briefing.headline: Nvidia reported strong quarterly results and a $130 billion revenue forecast, easing some fears about CEO Jensen Huang's exit, though questions about his departure remain.

points.text: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO. Colette Kress is now interim CEO. Nvidia's board chair said the board does not intend to rehire him.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: Nvidia's revenue grew strongly and its quarterly forecast is $130 billion. MarketWatch said this shows chip demand is still very high.
points.label: reported

points.text: Nvidia's stock rose after the results. Analysts said the blowout numbers eased worries about the CEO change.
points.label: reported

points.text: Huang is under an investigation by the board into his relationship with an alleged Chinese intelligence-linked executive. He says he will cooperate.
points.label: reported

points.text: Anthropic's IPO is expected to price above the $70 to $78 range. Investors see it as a key test for the AI boom.
